decisions.reason: As a multi-model platform product line central to the firm's announced direction of integrated enterprise geospatial solutions, with heavy investment and growing visibility (its own page by 2019), management is strongly committed and will persist with it.

Mobile field data capture is close to the core offer, was consistently presented on its own page, and fits the firm's enterprise integration story, so sunk development effort and visible commitment favor keeping it despite uncertain results.

Although sibling plugins A, B and C were already pruned, this search extension stayed visibly presented and is cheap to maintain on top of the platform, so management is inclined to persist and attribute weak uptake to temporary causes, though dropping is a real risk.
